newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's SBI surges over 7 pct, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's SBI surges over 7 pct, more gains seen.

text.p: The Slovenian blue-chip SBI .SBI index surged 7.74 percent or 103.81 points on Wednesday to record the highest daily rise to date, with market sentiment buoyed by a relaxation of rules for foreign investors.

"If there will be no unpleasant surprises regarding investment rules or Slovenia's plan to join the European Union as soon as possible, the index could reach 2,000 points by the end of the year," one said. The SBI closed at 1,444.40 points.
The central bank last week enabled foreigners to invest without incurring extra bank charges provided they hold onto a share for at least seven years, or trade among themselves.
* The SBI index rose 103.81 points to 1,444.4 points. The previous largest daily jump was recorded on February 17, when index went gained 97.73 points.
* Petrol trader Petrol was the most active share, up 8.43 percent to 20,580 tolars on volume of 5,969. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
